title: Genesis 7:4-7: seven more days, forty days of rain, Noah is 600 and enters the ark
summary: Genesis 7:4-7 in English: after seven more days God will send rain for forty days and forty nights and blot out every living thing; Noah obeys the LORD, is six hundred years old when the flood comes, and enters the ark with his sons, wife and sons' wives.

text.text: 4 “For after seven more days, I will send rain on the earth forty days and forty nights; and I will blot out from the face of the land every living thing that I have made.”
5 Noah did according to all that the LORD had commanded him.
6 Now Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of water came upon the earth.
7 Then Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives with him entered the ark because of the water of the flood.
